calculation_handling.description: Amending instruction (By-law 1075-2026, item 34): adds new article 150.8.75, clause 150.8.75.1 and regulation 150.8.75.1(1) to Zoning By-law 569-2013.
calculation_handling.gaps: Instruction text only; the added regulation is keyed in the (1) unit. The item number 34 is an enacting-by-law section number, not a literal.

calculation_handling.description: A heating, ventilation and air conditioning device associated with a laneway suite: (A) on the laneway suite building it may encroach up to 0.9 m into a required building setback or front yard setback if no closer than 0.3 m to a lot line, may sit on the roof and exceed the building's maximum height by 2.0 m, and may be on a platform; (B) if ground mounted it may encroach up to 0.9 m into a required building setback or separation distance if no closer than 0.3 m to a lot line, and must be within 2.0 m of a main wall or platform.
calculation_handling.gaps: The unit holds several limbs; keyed as a LIMIT on encroachment_m (the 0.9 m maximum, one statement per limb that sets it). The 0.3 m lot-line distance in (A)(i), (A)(ii), (B)(i), (B)(ii) is the condition of each encroachment (it could also be read as an encroachment_clearance_m minimum; a LIMIT names one target, so it is listed as not expressed). The 2.0 m in (A)(iii) is a permitted height exceedance for rooftop devices (no DSL target for an exceedance over the height limit) and the 2.0 m in (B)(iii) is a location requirement (within 2.0 m of a main wall or platform); neither has a fitting target, threshold_used_in_application is the closest closed reason. (A)(iv) (may be located on a platform) is a permission with no literal. HVAC device placement is a design fact; not evaluated.

units.disclosure: Heating, ventilation and air conditioning equipment for a laneway suite may project up to 0.9 m into setbacks (staying at least 0.3 m from lot lines), may sit on the roof up to 2.0 m above the height limit, and ground-mounted units must be within 2.0 m of a wall or platform. We do not check equipment placement.

150.8.75.1(1)@1075-2026.explanation: By-law 1075-2026 adds a rule for laneway suite heating, ventilation and air conditioning equipment: units mounted on the suite or on the ground may project up to 0.9 m into required setbacks (or, on the ground, into the separation from the house) if they stay at least 0.3 m from any lot line; rooftop units may extend up to 2.0 m above the height limit; units may sit on a deck; and ground-mounted units must be within 2.0 m of a wall or deck.
